responsibility: This file implements GCC’s human-readable tree dumping and debugging support. It prints tree nodes in brief or recursive forms, tracks already-visited nodes to avoid repetition, formats constants, declarations, types, locations, and many tree-code-specific fields, and provides debug entry points that either use raw structural printers or language hooks. It is the main low-level tree inspection and dump engine used for debugging compiler IR.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual tree-node dump and debug printers, including recursive formatting, visited-node tracking, and debug entry points, whereas print-tree.h only publishes those interfaces and flags.
